_comment: PRE-REGISTRATION for the StockFlow first-project example: the canonical F1-stock-visibility story + AC breakdown (from the recorded reference corpus). Staged to .consort/registration.json; the design-spec gate's registered-breakdown guard halts fail-closed if the live design lane derives a different breakdown (e.g. invents an app-shell story, renames/drops a story, or restructures a story's ACs). Matched by SLUG, so ordinals may shift. Covers F1 only; other features (F2-F9) are unguarded (the guard no-ops without a matching feature_id).
